_doc: Gold standard for retrieval eval. Copy to gold_dataset.json and fill one entry per query. expected_chunks[].content_hash (sha256 of normalized text) is the MATCHED identity — the eval converts each span _key to its content hash and compares. chunk_key is the ArangoDB _key (dump_chunks.py's key field), retained for traceability only. categoryLabels is a LIST of crop labels (supports multi-crop queries). serviceLabels narrows by topic. reference_answer is ground truth for the LLM-judge path.

entries.query: How do I apply for an agricultural subsidy?
entries.reference_answer: Submit form X to the ministry with proof of land ownership.
